name: gate_short_quote
about: A five-character quote would match almost any codebase, so it proves nothing and is rejected before any model call is spent on it.
diff:
diff --git a/retry.py b/retry.py
--- a/retry.py
+++ b/retry.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def backoff(attempt):
-    return 2 ** attempt
+    x = 1
+    return x * 2 ** attempt
